notes.title: A Quick but Notable Update
notes.notes:
Rusty Flesh's demo has just been updated with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Projectiles now render over other sprites.
[*] ​Added controller support to the PC version (Steam) thanks to the [url=https://eastpixel.itch.io/gbcbag]GBCBag 2[/url] tool by Chris at EASTPIXEL​.
[/list]

In addition, I'm not planning to keep updating the demo until after the full game launches, unless new critical bugs are discovered. I need to focus on finishing the game, and with this, the demo should be polished enough to grant an enjoyable experience.

​Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Demo Update: Ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi, it's definitely been a while! But no worries, I've been working hard on Rusty Flesh, and I'll have some exciting news [i]very[/i] soon.

But meanwhile, the demo build has been updated with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made the pause and map screens unavailable.
[*] Improved acceleration and deceleration responsiveness.
[*] Undead soldiers (green uniform) now revive faster after stunning them.
[/list]

Not much, huh? But the game does feel much better now after these simple improvements, and [b]Rusty Flesh's demo is ready for the February 2025 edition of Steam Next Fest![/b] This means that there will be no better time to try it and wishlist it than February 24 - March 3.

See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Update: New Splash Screen and more
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and happy spooky season!

I've been wanting to update Rusty Flesh's demo for a while now, and finally, here it is! This is what has changed:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from correctly switching gravity when standing on an object (platforms, boxes...).
[*] Created a new splash screen.
[*] Fixed some minor narrative inconsistencies.
[*] Some minor graphic improvements.
[/list]

Also, the Engines area is [i]almost[/i] ready, and I'm working on releasing a new trailer soon! I'll keep you posted. Oh, and remember that to wishlist Rusty Flesh!

notes.title: Demo Update: Improvements, Bug Fixes and New Content
notes.notes:
Howdy!

It's been a while, but I'm back with some updates. I actually wanted to update the demo a while ago, but some of the bug fixes I implemented created new, bigger bugs, I wasn't satisfied with how certain puzzles felt, and so on. Anyway, Rusty Flesh demo has been finally updated, and here's a list of the changes:

[list]
[*] Modified a room where it was impossible to go back without dying.
[*] Slightly increased the difficulty of two puzzles that were reported to be way too easy.
[*] Added a small section of the vents area (a top-down area that will serve as a shortcut between different places and hide some secrets).
[*] Fixed a transition between rooms that sent the player to a wrong place.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could die when walking from a moving platform.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it! I'll keep working on the Engines area, and hopefully I will have something to show soon.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update: Living Crates and Inconsistencies
notes.notes:
Happy Friday!

Rusty Flesh demo has been updated, fixing some issues that went under the radar. These are the changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crate that could float in the air when in certain positions.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to push some crates from a distance.
[*] Tweaked some color palettes for improved consistency.
[*] Fixed a narrative inconsistency.
[/list]

Have a nice weekend!
